component.name: PUM Lite
component.summary: Play tabletop RPGs like D&D by yourself and turn them into stories

description.p: PUM Lite helps you play tabletop RPGs like D&D by yourself and turn your adventures into stories. It combines creative prompts, Plot Unfolding Machine mechanics, and journaling tools to help you decide what happens next, develop characters and plot threads, and record your adventure as it unfolds.
Use PUM Lite to play a solo tabletop RPG, explore a character, prepare a campaign, or turn your game sessions into creative writing.
